spans.s: अन्य pron. (f. न्या, n. न्यत्) 1. Other in general, e.g. क्रियन्ते कटास्त्वया मयाऽन्यैश्च; 2. other than, different from, (with abl. or as the last member of a compound, e.g. उत्थितं ददृशोऽन्यच्च कबन्धेभ्यो न किञ्चन); 3. extraordinary, अन्या जगद्धितमयी मनसः प्रवृत्तिः Bh.V.i.69, or धन्या मृदन्यैव सा.(अन्य-अन्य or एक-अन्य = the one-the other, अन्यदुच्छृंखलं सत्वमन्यच्छास्त्रनियंत्रितम् Sis.ii.62. The neuter अन्यत् especially with a following च occurs frequently in the sense of ‘besides,’ ‘moreover,’ to connect sentences loosely joined together.)

अन्य-दुर्वह a. difficult to be borne by others.

अन्य-वाप m. the Kokila or Indian cuckoo.

अन्य-स्त्री f. a woman not one’s own. In rhetoric, she is one of the three categories of the principal female characters in a poetical composition, the other two being स्वीया and साधारणस्त्री. अन्यस्त्री is either ‘another’s wife,’ or ‘a damsel.’ As ‘another’s wife,’ she is fond of festivals and the like opportunities, is a disgrace to her family, bare of modesty. The ‘damsel’ is one not yet married, bashful and arrived at the age of puberty.
अन्य-स्त्री˚ग m. an adulterer.
अन्यक m. The same as अन्य q.v.
अन्यतरतस् ind. On one of two sides.
अन्यतरेद्युस् ind. On either of two days, on the one day or or on the other.
अन्यतस् ind. Used in the sense of the abl. or loc. of अन्य.(अन्यतस्-अन्यतस् or एकतस्-अन्यतस् = on the one side-on the other, तपनमण्डलदीपितमेकतः सततनैशतमोवृतमन्यतः Kir.v.2.)
अन्यत्र ind. Used in the sense of the loc. of अन्य, absolutely or with the ellipsis of a word implying ‘place,’ ‘manner’ &c.

अन्यथा ind. 1. In a different manner, differently, भावि चेन्न तदन्यथा Hit.i.; 2. otherwise, else, e.g. अन्यथा हि विरोधः ‘otherwise there would be contradiction’; 3. on the other hand, on the contrary; 4. untruly, e.g. अन्यथावादिनो यस्य ध्रुवस्तस्य पराजयः; 5. badly, wrongly, erroneously (as in अन्यथासिद्ध). अन्यथा in combination with the root कृ, धा with वि &c. means ‘to undo,’ ‘to change.’
अन्यथा-कारम् ind. doing otherwise, differently, e.g. अन्यथाकारं भुंक्ते.
अन्यथा-ख्याति f. erroneous conception of spirit.
अन्यथा-भाव m. alteration, difference.
अन्यथा-वादिन् a. speaking differently, prevaricating (in law).
अन्यथा-वृत्ति a. 1. altered; 2. disturbed by strong emotions.
अन्यथा-सिद्ध (I) a. wrongly proved or established (referring to a cause which is not the true cause).
अन्यथा-सिद्ध (II) n. an unessential cause, a concomitant circumstance (in logic).
अन्यथा-स्तोत्र n. untrue or ironical praise (यत्र विकृताकृतिरेव दर्शनीयस्त्वमसीत्युच्यते तदन्यथास्तोत्रम्).

अन्यदा ind. 1. At another time, on all other occasions than the one under question, e.g. अन्यदा भूषणं पुंसां क्षमा लज्जेव योषिताम् । पराक्रमः परिभवे वैयात्यं सुरतेष्विव Sis.ii.44, R.xi.73; 2. at one time, once, once upon a time.
अन्यदीय a. (f. या) 1. Belonging to another; 2. being in another.
अन्यदीय a. (f. या) 1. Belonging to another; 2. being in another.
अन्यर्हि ind. At another time, (the same as अन्यदा).

अन्याय m.^1 1. An unjust or unlawful action; 2. injustice, impropriety; 3. irregularity.
